name: Markdown tasks to Apple Reminders (Mac app)

mentions.name: Markdown tasks to Apple Reminders (Mac app)
mentions.description: A Mac app that syncs markdown tasks to Apple Reminders. Originally released for Obsidian, it was rebranded to work with plain markdown files, and features were added along with a price increase.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A little Mac app that syncs markdown tasks to Apple Reminders.

Initially I released it for obsidian: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39764919 but realised it works with just markdown so I rebranded the app, added some new features and increased prices.
